title: 英語教甄考古題練習題庫

schema.options: 每題選項、中文意思與是否為正解

sources.title: 114-115 學年度英文試題解析 — 各校答案詳解（第二冊）
115 學年度高中英文試題解析 — 各校答案詳解

questions.question_text: In a reading unit on climate change, students are not given direct answers but are asked to formulate questions, research answers, and present their conclusions. Which instructional approach is most clearly demonstrated?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在氣候變遷閱讀單元中，學生被要求自行提問、研究答案並呈現結論。最清楚展示了哪種教學方法？
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Inquiry-Based Instruction」，意思是「探究式教學」。

questions.question_text: According to Vygotsky's sociocultural theory, which teaching practice best supports students' learning within their Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD)?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 根據維高斯基的社會文化理論，哪種教學實踐最能支持學生在最近發展區（ZPD）內的學習？

options.label: A
options.text: Allowing students to work independently on tasks they have already mastered
options.meaning_zh: 讓學生獨立完成已掌握的任務

options.label: B
options.text: Providing guided support during tasks students cannot yet complete on their own
options.meaning_zh: 在學生尚無法獨立完成的任務中提供引導性支持

options.label: C
options.text: Designing collaborative activities where more capable peers assist
options.meaning_zh: 設計讓能力較強的同儕協助解決問題的合作活動

options.label: D
options.text: Implementing differentiated challenges through strategic teacher mediation
options.meaning_zh: 通過策略性師生中介實施差異化挑戰

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Providing guided support during tasks students cannot yet complete on their own」，意思是「在學生尚無法獨立完成的任務中提供引導性支持」。

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements reflects the principles of backward design in curriculum planning?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 以下哪項陳述反映了課程規劃中「逆向設計」的原則？

options.label: A
options.text: Teachers begin by choosing textbook chapters to follow.
options.meaning_zh: 教師從選擇教科書章節開始

options.label: B
options.text: The course is structured around thematic units selected by students.
options.meaning_zh: 課程圍繞學生選擇的主題單元構建

options.label: C
options.text: Instructional activities are selected before the learning goals are finalized.
options.meaning_zh: 在確定學習目標之前先選擇教學活動

options.label: D
options.text: The learning outcomes are determined first, followed by assessment and instruction.
options.meaning_zh: 先確定學習結果，再設計評量和教學

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「The learning outcomes are determined first, followed by assessment and instruction.」，意思是「先確定學習結果，再設計評量和教學」。

questions.question_text: After a national English exam shifts its focus from grammar drills to essay writing, teachers start assigning more writing tasks. What concept best explains the change in classroom instruction?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 國家英語考試重心從語法練習轉向作文後，教師開始布置更多寫作任務。哪個概念最能解釋課堂教學的這一變化？
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Washback effect」，意思是「回沖效應」。

questions.question_text: A teacher designs a vocabulary quiz with rare idioms and obscure slang never covered in class. Students score poorly. Which best describes the main flaw?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 教師設計了一份詞彙測驗，包含課堂從未涉及的罕見成語和晦澀俚語，學生得分很低。哪項最能描述這份測驗的主要缺陷？

options.label: A
options.text: It lacks authenticity in task design.

options.label: B
options.text: It lacks face validity for the students.

options.label: C
options.text: It lacks reliability due to cultural bias.
options.meaning_zh: 因文化偏見而缺乏信度

options.label: D
options.text: It lacks content validity in relation to instruction.
options.meaning_zh: 與教學相關的內容效度不足

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「It lacks content validity in relation to instruction.」，意思是「與教學相關的內容效度不足」。

questions.question_text: The art exhibition used clever _____ of historical and contemporary photographs to highlight both the changes and continuities in urban landscapes over the past century.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這場藝術展覽巧妙地並列對照（juxtaposition）歷史與當代照片，突顯了過去一個世紀城市景觀的變化與延續。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「juxtaposition」，意思是「並列對照；並置」。

questions.question_text: The manager gave only a _____ review of the proposal before rejecting it, clearly not having taken the time to understand its innovative approach.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 經理在拒絕提案之前只進行了草率（perfunctory）的審查，顯然沒有花時間了解其創新方法。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「perfunctory」，意思是「敷衍了事的；草率的」。

questions.question_text: The theater critic noted that the actor's lengthy _____ in the third act revealed the character's inner turmoil with remarkable subtlety and emotional depth.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 戲劇評論家注意到，演員在第三幕中冗長的獨白（soliloquy）以非凡的細膩和情感深度揭示了角色的內心矛盾。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「soliloquy」，意思是「獨白；自言自語」。

questions.question_text: The chef skillfully _____ traditional French cooking techniques with Japanese ingredients to create a unique fusion cuisine that honored both culinary traditions.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位廚師巧妙地融合（amalgamated）傳統法國烹飪技術與日本食材，創造出獨特的融合料理，致敬兩種烹飪傳統。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「amalgamated」，意思是「融合；混合」。

questions.question_text: The hospital administrator faced an ethical _____ when limited resources meant choosing between funding the emergency department's expansion or purchasing new cancer treatment equipment.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 醫院管理員面臨道德難題（conundrum），因為有限的資源意味著需要在資助急診室擴建或購買新的癌症治療設備之間做出選擇。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「conundrum」，意思是「難題；謎題」。

questions.question_text: The wealthy heiress felt a profound _____ despite her material advantages, finding that her luxurious lifestyle provided little genuine fulfillment or purpose.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位富有的女繼承人儘管擁有物質優勢，卻深感無聊空虛（ennui），發現她奢華的生活方式幾乎無法帶來真正的滿足感或人生意義。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「ennui」，意思是「無聊；厭倦」。

questions.question_text: The new policy had a _____ effect on employee morale, leading to increased turnover rates.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 新政策對員工士氣產生了有害（deleterious）的影響，導致離職率上升。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「deleterious」，意思是「有害的；有毒的」。

questions.question_text: In a peer review session, students were asked to ______ each other's essays for grammatical errors.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在同儕審查課程中，學生被要求仔細審查（scrutinize）彼此的文章，尋找語法錯誤。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「scrutinize」，意思是「仔細審查；細察」。

questions.question_text: After a three-hour delay, the passengers grew increasingly ______ and began demanding answers from the airline staff.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在延誤三小時後，乘客越來越焦躁不安（agitated），開始向航空公司工作人員要求解釋。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「agitated」，意思是「焦躁的；煩亂的」。

questions.question_text: By the time the technician arrived to fix the issue, the system ______ twice, causing panic among staff members working on urgent projects.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 到技術人員趕到修復問題時，系統已經崩潰了（had crashed）兩次，在從事緊急專案的員工中引發了恐慌。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: （假設語氣，不符合敘述性過去事實）

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: （現在完成式，與by the time子句時態不符）

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 過去完成式，表在另一過去時間點之前已發生

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「had crashed」，意思是「過去完成式，表在另一過去時間點之前已發生」。

questions.question_text: The city implemented a strict curfew in an attempt to ________ the rapid spread of the virus during the early phase of the outbreak.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 該市實施了嚴格的宵禁，試圖在疫情初期阻礙（impede）病毒的快速傳播。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「impede」，意思是「阻礙；妨礙」。

questions.question_text: In diasporic communities, the younger generation often finds itself caught between preserving ancestral traditions and embracing a more ________ identity shaped by the host culture.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在海外移民社區中，年輕一代往往發現自己夾在保存祖先傳統與接受由所在地文化塑造的更混合性（hybrid）身份之間。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「hybrid」，意思是「混合的；混種的」。

questions.question_text: The conservator meticulously attempted to ________ the priceless manuscript, using a laser to create a single, extremely small hole for analysis.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 保護者細心地嘗試在珍貴手稿上穿孔（perforate），使用雷射製作一個極小的孔洞進行分析。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「perforate」，意思是「穿孔；打孔」。

questions.question_text: Despite the board's initial enthusiasm, the proposal was ultimately rejected due to concerns that its assumptions were excessively ________ and lacked empirical evidence and feasible forecasts.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管董事會最初充滿熱情，但該提案最終因其假設過於推測性（speculative）且缺乏實驗證據和可行預測而遭到拒絕。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「speculative」，意思是「推測的；投機的」。

questions.question_text: The defendant's seemingly sincere apology was perceived by many as a ________ gesture, strategically designed to sway public opinion prior to sentencing.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 被告看似誠摯的道歉被許多人視為刻意做作（contrived）的姿態，是在宣判前刻意設計來左右輿論的。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「contrived」，意思是「人為的；刻意為之的」。

questions.question_text: As her fame grew, the once accessible author became progressively more ________, avoiding interviews and refusing to engage with fans.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 隨著名氣增長，這位曾經平易近人的作家變得越來越隱居（reclusive），迴避採訪並拒絕與粉絲互動。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「reclusive」，意思是「隱居的；避世的」。

questions.question_text: His arguments, though initially persuasive, gradually fell apart upon closer examination, revealing a disturbing pattern of ________ reasoning.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他的論點雖然最初頗具說服力，但仔細審視後逐漸站不住腳，揭示了一種令人不安的謬誤性（fallacious）推理模式。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 有說服力的；令人信服的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「fallacious」，意思是「謬誤的；邏輯錯誤的」。

questions.question_text: The scientist's innovative methods were initially met with skepticism; however, her research findings eventually gained ________ within academic communities.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位科學家的創新方法最初受到懷疑；然而，她的研究成果最終在學術界獲得了關注與支持（traction）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「traction」，意思是「牽引力；認可與推動」。

questions.question_text: Although many criticized the CEO's decision as reckless, others praised it as a ________ move that positioned the company ahead of its competitors.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然許多人批評執行長的決定魯莽，但其他人讚揚它是一個有先見之明（prescient）的舉動，使公司領先於競爭對手。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「prescient」，意思是「有先見之明的；預知的」。

questions.question_text: Mr. Clinton's memoir is filled with ________ reflections that illustrate a man who has grappled deeply with regret and redemption.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 克林頓先生的回憶錄充滿了深刻感人（poignant）的省思，描繪了一個深刻地與遺憾和救贖搏鬥的人。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「poignant」，意思是「深刻感人的；辛酸的」。

questions.question_text: The diplomat's carefully articulated statement managed to ________ tensions while refraining from committing to any specific course of action.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位外交官精心措辭的聲明在不承諾任何具體行動方案的情況下，成功地緩和了（mollify）緊張局勢。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「mollify」，意思是「安撫；緩和」。

questions.question_text: Critics argue that the policy, although well-intentioned, may inadvertently ________ the very communities it seeks to protect.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 批評者認為，該政策雖然出發點良好，卻可能無意中疏遠（alienate）它試圖保護的社區。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「alienate」，意思是「疏遠；使敵對」。

questions.question_text: The organization asserted its commitment to transparency; however, its decision-making process remained frustratingly ________.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 該組織聲稱致力於透明度；然而，其決策過程仍令人沮喪地不透明（opaque）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「opaque」，意思是「不透明的；晦澀的」。

questions.question_text: The professor's remarks were not meant to disparage the student but rather to ________ a more profound engagement with the subject matter.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 教授的話並非為了貶低學生，而是為了激發（galvanize）學生對學科內容更深層次的投入。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「galvanize」，意思是「激勵；刺激」。

questions.question_text: The committee was impressed by the candidate's ________ response, which effectively tackled the complexities of the issue while avoiding oversimplification.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 委員會對候選人有深度有細膩（nuanced）的回應印象深刻，該回應在避免過度簡化的同時有效地解決了問題的複雜性。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「nuanced」，意思是「細膩的；有細微差別的」。

questions.question_text: While the software promised seamless integration, its implementation proved to be so ________ that several departments reverted to manual systems.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然該軟體承諾無縫整合，但其實施被證明如此繁瑣（cumbersome），以至於幾個部門恢復使用手動系統。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「cumbersome」，意思是「繁瑣的；笨重的」。

questions.question_text: The CEO's response was deliberately ________; he neither confirmed nor denied the allegations but spoke in generalities.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位執行長的回應是刻意迴避（evasive）的；他既不確認也不否認指控，只是泛泛而談。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「evasive」，意思是「迴避的；含糊的」。

questions.question_text: The dilapidated table was scratched and_______; a thick book had been wedged underneath its short leg.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那張破舊的桌子被劃花了，而且歪斜不平（lopsided）；一本厚書被塞在短腿下面。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「lopsided」，意思是「傾斜的；不平衡的」。

questions.question_text: He tried not to look_______ and moved slowly along the back of the room.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他試圖不讓自己太顯眼（conspicuous），沿著房間後部緩慢移動。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「conspicuous」，意思是「顯眼的；引人注目的」。

questions.question_text: His negative attitude slowly and _______spoiled the atmosphere around the office.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他的負面態度慢慢地、潛移默化地（insidiously）破壞了辦公室的氛圍。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「insidiously」，意思是「潛移默化地；陰險地」。

questions.question_text: The_______ condition of many of the city school buildings was very shocking.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 許多城市學校建築的骯髒惡劣（sordid）狀況非常令人震驚。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「sordid」，意思是「骯髒的；卑劣的」。

questions.question_text: The candidate's lousy behavior during the debate turned what could have been a victory into a political_______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 候選人在辯論中的糟糕表現，將本可贏得的勝利變成了一場政治大潰敗（debacle）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「debacle」，意思是「慘敗；大潰敗」。

questions.question_text: Some accounting firms have been notoriously_______ about the finances in the past.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 過去，一些會計師事務所在財務方面出了名地不透明（opaque）。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 擦傷的；因摩擦而疼痛的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「opaque」，意思是「不透明的；晦澀的」。

questions.question_text: The actor was_______ by the press as a racist scum.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位演員被媒體誹謗（vilified）為種族主義者的敗類。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vilified」，意思是「誹謗；污名化」。

questions.question_text: The company will _______all your expenses, inclusive of car rental.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 公司將支付（defray）您的所有費用，包括租車費用。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「defray」，意思是「支付（費用）；負擔」。

questions.question_text: We_______ our management system, but the business is doing no better than it was before.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 我們改革了（revamped）我們的管理系統，但業務並不比以前更好。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「revamped」，意思是「改革；翻新」。

questions.question_text: He has tried to_______ and destroy everyone whose viewpoints differ from his.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他試圖誹謗（calumniate）並摧毀每一個與他觀點不同的人。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「calumniate」，意思是「誹謗；中傷」。

questions.question_text: Helen despised nosy neighbors who tried to ________ into her personal life, bombarding her with intrusive questions about her job or relationships.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Helen 討厭愛管閒事的鄰居，他們試圖窺探（pry）她的私生活，用關於她工作或感情的侵犯性問題轟炸她。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「pry」，意思是「窺探；探聽」。

questions.question_text: The investigative journalist was shocked when he received a(n) ________ demanding that he reveal the confidential sources behind his recent exposé on government corruption.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位調查記者在收到一份傳票（subpoena）要求他揭露其最近關於政府腐敗報導的機密消息來源時，感到震驚。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「subpoena」，意思是「傳票；傳喚令」。

questions.question_text: After a few too many glasses of wine, Jack became ________, tearfully recounting old stories about his high school sweetheart who had long since moved on.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 多喝了幾杯酒後，Jack 變得感傷（maudlin），含淚回憶著早已移情別戀的高中初戀的往事。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 因喝酒而傷感的；多愁善感的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「maudlin」，意思是「因喝酒而傷感的；多愁善感的」。

questions.question_text: The artist was able to ________ the bustling cityscape with such meticulous detail that every building, shadow, and reflection looked almost lifelike.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位藝術家能夠如此細膩地描繪（render）繁忙的城市景觀，以至於每棟建築、每道陰影和每個倒影看起來都幾乎栩栩如生。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「render」，意思是「呈現；描繪」。

questions.question_text: Sabrina's ________ remarks during the meeting left her coworkers stunned, as no one had expected such biting sarcasm from her.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Sabrina 在會議中的刻薄（caustic）言論讓她的同事們目瞪口呆，因為沒有人預料到她會說出如此尖銳的諷刺。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 多才多藝的；用途廣泛的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「caustic」，意思是「刻薄的；腐蝕性的」。

questions.question_text: The conference brought together a(n) ________ group of experts, ranging from medical researchers to technology developers, to discuss the future of artificial intelligence in healthcare.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這次會議匯聚了一群各異（disparate）的專家，從醫學研究人員到技術開發人員，討論人工智慧在醫療保健領域的未來。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「disparate」，意思是「迥異的；不同種類的」。

questions.question_text: Jessica tried not to let her younger brother's teasing ________ her, but after hours of his relentless jokes, she finally snapped.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Jessica 試圖不讓弟弟的戲弄惹怒（vex）她，但在他無休止的玩笑持續數小時後，她終於爆發了。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vex」，意思是「惹怒；使煩惱」。

questions.question_text: The ________ of online misinformation makes it increasingly difficult for people to distinguish between factual news and fabricated stories.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 網路錯誤資訊的大量盛行（preponderance）使人們越來越難以區分事實新聞和捏造故事。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「preponderance」，意思是「優勢；佔大多數」。

questions.question_text: John disliked overly ________ people, preferring friends and colleagues who were honest with him rather than those who showered him with excessive, insincere praise.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: John 不喜歡過度奉承（obsequious）的人，偏好對他誠實的朋友和同事，而非用過多、不誠摯的讚美淋沒他的那種人。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「obsequious」，意思是「阿諛奉承的；諂媚的」。

questions.question_text: While having a(n) ________ of information at our fingertips is a great advantage, it can also be overwhelming when we try to sift through conflicting sources.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然手邊有大量（plethora）資訊是一大優勢，但當我們試圖篩選相互矛盾的來源時，也可能令人不知所措。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「plethora」，意思是「大量；過多」。

questions.question_text: What is the main advantage of writing 'identity texts' for language education?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 為語言教育撰寫「身份文本」的主要優點是什麼？

options.label: A
options.text: They focus on collaborative learning in schools.

options.label: B
options.text: They facilitate an enhancement of vocabulary and grammar.
options.meaning_zh: 促進詞彙和語法的提升

options.label: C
options.text: They enable students to use language to communicate their cultural identities.
options.meaning_zh: 使學生能用語言表達其文化身份

options.label: D
options.text: They give precedence to Western cultural norms over alternative viewpoints.
options.meaning_zh: 將西方文化規範置於其他觀點之上

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「They enable students to use language to communicate their cultural identities.」，意思是「使學生能用語言表達其文化身份」。

questions.question_text: How is language primarily perceived from the viewpoint of cognitive linguistics?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 從認知語言學的觀點來看，語言主要被如何看待？

options.label: A
options.text: It reflects rules and structures distinct from human experiences.
options.meaning_zh: 反映與人類經驗無關的規則和結構

options.label: B
options.text: It reveals a stable system that has been passed down from biological evolution.
options.meaning_zh: 揭示由生物演化傳承的穩定系統

options.label: C
options.text: It reveals social construct founded on cultural norms.
options.meaning_zh: 揭示建立在文化規範上的社會建構

options.label: D
options.text: It reflects bodily experiences and broader cognitive processes.
options.meaning_zh: 反映身體經驗和更廣泛的認知過程

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「It reflects bodily experiences and broader cognitive processes.」，意思是「反映身體經驗和更廣泛的認知過程」。

questions.question_text: Which teaching theory places emphasis on interpersonal communication in the classroom?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 哪種教學理論強調課堂中的人際溝通？
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Constructivism」，意思是「建構主義」。

questions.question_text: In the Input Hypothesis proposed by Stephen Krashen, what is the ideal type of input for language learners?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在 Stephen Krashen 提出的輸入假說中，語言學習者的理想輸入類型是什麼？

options.label: A
options.text: Input that is slightly beyond their current proficiency level.
options.meaning_zh: 略高於目前能力水準的輸入（i+1）

options.label: B
options.text: Repetitive input at their current level.
options.meaning_zh: 在其目前水準的重複輸入

options.label: C
options.text: Input that focuses exclusively on grammatical structures.
options.meaning_zh: 專注於語法結構的輸入

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 與學習者目標無關的輸入

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Input that is slightly beyond their current proficiency level.」，意思是「略高於目前能力水準的輸入（i+1）」。

questions.question_text: How does the integration of technology in the ESL classroom best address diverse learning styles?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在 ESL 課堂中整合技術如何最有效地滿足多樣化的學習風格？

options.label: A
options.text: Focusing on the instruction of traditional lecture methods.
options.meaning_zh: 專注於傳統講課法教學

options.label: B
options.text: Utilizing adaptive learning platforms that provide interactive multimedia content tailored to individual needs.
options.meaning_zh: 使用提供符合個人需求之互動多媒體內容的自適應學習平台

options.label: C
options.text: Using text-based digital resources, together with minimal audio-video elements.
options.meaning_zh: 使用以文字為主的數位資源，搭配極少的影音元素

options.label: D
options.text: Readdressing classroom interaction by incorporating solitary, technology-based computer tasks.
options.meaning_zh: 以單獨的電腦作業取代課堂互動

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Utilizing adaptive learning platforms that provide interactive multimedia content tailored to individual needs.」，意思是「使用提供符合個人需求之互動多媒體內容的自適應學習平台」。

questions.question_text: Many people found it difficult to follow because the reasoning was so _____.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 許多人發現很難跟上，因為推理如此錯綜複雜（convoluted）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「convoluted」，意思是「錯綜複雜的；費解的」。

questions.question_text: As the disease begins to _____ the brain, people may undergo changes in personality.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 隨著疾病開始侵害（ravage）大腦，人們可能會出現性格上的變化。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「ravage」，意思是「嚴重損害；蹂躪」。

questions.question_text: Environmentalists around the world have _____ the organization's efforts to combat climate change.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 世界各地的環保人士讚揚了（lauded）該組織為應對氣候變化所做的努力。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「lauded」，意思是「讚揚；頌揚」。

questions.question_text: Immediately after completing the study of astronomy, he developed some crude instrumentation to detect radiation.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 完成天文學研究後，他立即開發了一些粗製（crude）的儀器來探測輻射。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「crude」，意思是「粗製的；簡陋的」。

questions.question_text: He was an original composer, less cloyingly sentimental than his contemporaries.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他是一位有原創性的作曲家，比同時代的人少了幾分令人生厭的（cloyingly）傷感。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「cloyingly」，意思是「膩煩地；過度甜膩地」。

questions.question_text: Regardless of the source of the inaccurate headline, credible sources amplified it, resulting in a costly lesson for many large corporations and business leaders.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 不管不實頭條的來源如何，可信賴的媒體放大了（amplified）它，給許多大型企業和商業領袖帶來了慘痛的教訓。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「amplified」，意思是「放大；擴大」。

questions.question_text: Current medical research has shown that with the correct medication, combined with diet and lifestyle adjustments, there is a chance to 'reverse' the disease.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 目前的醫學研究表明，通過正確的藥物治療，結合飲食和生活方式的調整（adjustments），有機會「逆轉」這種疾病。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「adjustments」，意思是「調整；校正」。

questions.question_text: The report highlighted the urgent need for _____ policies, as pneumonia has become the third leading cause of death among seniors.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 報告強調了積極主動（proactive）政策的迫切需求，因為肺炎已成為老年人死亡的第三大原因。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「proactive」，意思是「積極主動的；預防性的」。

questions.question_text: The EU Commission proposed its first _____ tariffs at 25% on a wide range of US products.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 歐盟委員會提出了對多種美國產品徵收首批25%的報復性（retaliatory）關稅。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「retaliatory」，意思是「報復性的；反擊的」。

questions.question_text: Since the feature's release, users have overwhelmed the internet with images in the style of Studio Ghibli, raising copyright concerns.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 自該功能發布以來，用戶已用吉卜力工作室風格的圖像淹沒了網路，引發（raising）版權方面的擔憂。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 上升；起床（不及物動詞，不接受詞）

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「raising」，意思是「引發；提出」。

questions.question_text: The highly radioactive debris emitted lethal gamma rays that continuously destroyed the advanced robots deployed in a desperate attempt to clean up the catastrophic and hazardous mess left behind.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 高度放射性的碎片持續放出致命的伽瑪射線，不斷摧毀被派遣（deployed）去清理那場災難性危險廢墟的先進機器人。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「deployed」，意思是「部署；派遣」。

questions.question_text: Growing up together in Central Asia, Baheer and Medet were the best of friends, but everything changed when Medet reported Baheer to government authorities, leading to his arrest and excruciating torture.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在中亞一起長大，Baheer 和 Medet 曾是最好的朋友，但當 Medet 向政府當局舉報 Baheer，導致他被捕並遭受極度痛苦（excruciating）的酷刑後，一切都改變了。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「excruciating」，意思是「極度痛苦的；劇烈的」。

questions.question_text: Buoyed by their teacher's suggestion, Indiana students wrote encouraging notes that later lifted the spirits of peers coping with fear and pain after a school tragedy.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 受老師建議所鼓舞（Buoyed），印第安納州的學生們寫下了鼓勵的話語，這些話後來振奮了在學校悲劇後努力面對恐懼和痛苦的同學們的精神。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Buoyed」，意思是「鼓舞；使振奮」。

questions.question_text: A routine cable car ride in Pakistan became an arduous twelve-hour rescue mission after two cables snapped, leaving eight passengers, including schoolchildren, suspended hundreds of feet in the air.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在巴基斯坦的一次例行纜車搭乘，在兩條纜繩斷裂後演變成一場艱辛漫長（arduous）的十二小時救援任務，八名乘客（包括學童）被懸在數百英尺的高空。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「arduous」，意思是「艱辛的；費力的」。

questions.question_text: The peace talks, once filled with hope for resolution, are now mired in endless bureaucracy, with negotiations stalled by red tape, conflicting interests, and political maneuvering.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 曾充滿和解希望的和平談判，如今已深陷（mired）於無止盡的官僚體制中，談判因繁文縟節、利益衝突和政治操弄而停滯不前。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「mired」，意思是「深陷；使陷入困境」。

questions.question_text: A master piano tuner, Franz Mohr was sought after for his intricate knowledge of pianos and great skill developed over decades.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 鋼琴調音大師 Franz Mohr 以其對鋼琴精深複雜（intricate）的了解以及數十年磨練出的精湛技藝而備受追捧。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「intricate」，意思是「複雜精巧的；錯綜的」。

questions.question_text: Olive spent a month in the countryside, recuperating from the operation, allowing herself time to rest and heal.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Olive 在鄉間度過了一個月，從手術中康復（recuperating），讓自己有時間休息和痊癒。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「recuperating」，意思是「康復；恢復健康」。

questions.question_text: Joyce's home has a well-stocked bookshelf filled with pristine, unread hardcovers, reflecting my love for beautiful books over time.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Joyce 的家中有一個藏書豐富的書架，擺滿了嶄新（pristine）未讀的精裝書，反映了她長期以來對精美書籍的熱愛。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「pristine」，意思是「嶄新的；完好如初的」。

questions.question_text: The father and his daughter's effusive thanks for returning the prepaid bus pass left me feeling unexpectedly satisfied.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 父親和女兒對歸還預付公車票的熱情洋溢（effusive）道謝，讓我感到出乎意料的滿足。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 熱情洋溢的；過分熱情的

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 令人厭惡的；引起反感的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「effusive」，意思是「熱情洋溢的；過分熱情的」。

questions.question_text: The injured elephant calf, Long'uro, innately received support from the herd, as elephants naturally help and care for each other.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 受傷的小象 Long'uro 天生地（innately）獲得了象群的支持，因為大象天生就會互相幫助和照顧。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「innately」，意思是「天生地；先天地」。

questions.question_text: Whenever Amanda and I embark on our journey to the Golden Coast, we enthusiastically capture countless photographs as the breathtaking shoreline unfolds before us, showcasing skilled surfers.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 每當 Amanda 和我踏上前往黃金海岸的旅程，當壯麗的海岸線在我們眼前展開時（as），我們都熱情地拍攝無數的照片，記錄下技術高超的衝浪者。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「as」，意思是「當……時候（表時間）」。

questions.question_text: The stranded sailor had been lying unconscious on the rocky shore for hours when, by chance, a passing fisherman spotted him, recognizing the distress signals.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那名擱淺的水手已在岩石海岸上昏迷躺了（had been lying）數小時，偶然間被一名路過的漁夫發現，認出了求救信號。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 過去完成進行式，表持續到過去某時刻的動作

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「had been lying」，意思是「過去完成進行式，表持續到過去某時刻的動作」。

questions.question_text: Across peninsular Malaysia and the Bornean states of Sabah and Sarawak, the iconic canopy walks have been attracting both domestic and international visitors, offering an unparalleled opportunity to experience the region's rich biodiversity.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在馬來西亞半島及婆羅洲的沙巴和沙勞越州，標誌性的樹冠步道一直吸引著（have been attracting）國內外遊客，提供體驗該地區豐富生物多樣性的無與倫比機會。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 現在完成進行式，表持續到現在的動作

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「have been attracting」，意思是「現在完成進行式，表持續到現在的動作」。

questions.question_text: His convoluted stratagem, replete with manifold deficiencies, will inexorably be effectuated unless we contrive an alternative—manifestly more tenable—by Tuesday.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他那複雜的策略充滿了各種缺陷，將不可避免地被執行，除非（unless）我們在週二前想出另一個明顯更站得住腳的替代方案。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「unless」，意思是「除非」。

questions.question_text: Though he exudes an air of veracity and steadfastness, be ever mindful that he remains wholly unworthy of even the most infinitesimal modicum of trust.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然（Though）他散發出真誠和堅定的氣息，但請時刻記住，他完全不值得哪怕絲毫的信任。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 儘管如此；然而（副詞，不引導子句）

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Though」，意思是「雖然；儘管」。

questions.question_text: Not only did Joyce excel academically, but she also demonstrated remarkable leadership, creativity, resilience, and an unwavering dedication to her projects, earning the admiration of both peers and mentors.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Joyce 不僅在學業上表現出色，她還表現出（but she also demonstrated）非凡的領導力、創造力、韌性和對專案的堅定奉獻，贏得了同學和導師的讚賞。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: Not only...but also 倒裝結構

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: （連接詞用法不符合Not only句型）

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「but she also demonstrated」，意思是「Not only...but also 倒裝結構」。

questions.question_text: While Australia boasts breathtaking landscapes replete with stunning biodiversity, travelers must remain vigilant; however, the presence of venomous serpents, formidable arachnids, and stealthy predators necessitates caution.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然澳洲擁有充滿驚人生物多樣性的壯麗景觀，旅行者必須保持警惕；然而（however），毒蛇、可怕的蜘蛛和潛伏的掠食者的存在使謹慎變得必要。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「however」，意思是「然而；但是」。

questions.question_text: Due to the relentless downpour and the ferocious gusts that rendered the terrain inhospitable, their meticulously planned camping excursion was ultimately abandoned in disappointment.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於（Due to）無情的傾盆大雨和使地形惡劣的猛烈陣風，他們精心計畫的露營郊遊最終在失望中被迫放棄。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Due to」，意思是「由於；因為」。

questions.question_text: Julia remained silent throughout the high-stakes corporate negotiation, lest an ill-considered remark undermine the fragile discussions and jeopardize the meticulously crafted financial agreement at hand.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Julia 在高風險的企業談判中全程保持沉默，以免（lest）輕率的言論破壞脆弱的討論，危及精心制定的財務協議。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「lest」，意思是「以免；惟恐」。

questions.question_text: Users who experienced _______ side effects, such as stomach paralysis and chronic vomiting, after using Mounjaro®, a medication widely praised for its weight loss benefits, are currently filing lawsuits seeking medical compensation.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 使用因減重效果廣受讚譽的Mounjaro®後出現有害（deleterious）副作用（如胃癱和慢性嘔吐）的使用者，目前正在提起訴訟尋求醫療補償。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「deleterious」，意思是「有害的；有毒的」。

questions.question_text: The candidate's speech, while ostensibly conciliatory, subtly _______ the opposition's credibility, planting doubt in the minds of the electorate without directly attacking them.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位候選人的演講表面上看似和解，卻微妙地損害（vitiated）了反對黨的公信力，在未直接攻擊的情況下在選民心中播下疑慮。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vitiated」，意思是「損害；使無效」。

questions.question_text: The actress denied the dating scandal with such _______ that it paradoxically intensified public scrutiny of the very rumors she sought to dispel.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位女演員以極度激烈（vehemence）的態度否認戀愛醜聞，矛盾地加深了公眾對她試圖平息的謠言的關注。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vehemence」，意思是「激烈；強烈的情感」。

questions.question_text: With Billboard chart-toppers Golden from Kpop Demon Hunters and APT by BLACKPINK's Rosé earning Grammy nominations, Korean pop culture has _______ regional confines to assert itself as a preeminent force in the global cultural marketplace.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 隨著BLACKPINK Rosé的APT等K-pop歌曲登頂告示牌並獲葛萊美提名，韓國流行文化已超越（eclipsed）地區限制，在全球文化市場中確立了自己的卓越地位。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「eclipsed」，意思是「使相形見絀；超越」。

questions.question_text: By presenting contradictory accounts of the event, the journalist intentionally _______ attempts at any simple moral interpretation, forcing readers to confront ambiguity.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 透過呈現對事件相互矛盾的描述，這位記者故意讓（confounded）任何簡單的道德詮釋企圖都難以實現，迫使讀者面對模糊性。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「confounded」，意思是「使困惑；挫敗」。

questions.question_text: David rejected the proposal _______, making clear that no amount of revision would change his position.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 大衛斷然（categorically）拒絕了這項提案，明確表示無論如何修改都不會改變他的立場。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「categorically」，意思是「斷然地；明確地」。

questions.question_text: Clad in his customary _______ onyx leather uniform, the lieutenant exuded a lethal elegance, his commanding presence leaving the assembled soldiers spellbound.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 身著一貫潔白無瑕（immaculate）的黑玉色皮革制服，這位中尉散發出致命的優雅，其威嚴的氣場令列隊的士兵們神魂顛倒。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 潔白無瑕的；完美無缺的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「immaculate」，意思是「潔白無瑕的；完美無缺的」。

questions.question_text: The investigative report not only documented Epstein's financial improprieties but also _______ him for what it characterized as a calculated exploitation of institutional complacency.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這份調查報告不僅記錄了愛潑斯坦的財務不當行為，還嚴厲斥責（excoriated）他對機構自滿的蓄意利用。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「excoriated」，意思是「嚴厲斥責；痛批」。

questions.question_text: Despite its sleek design, the device feels oddly _______, responding well in some situations and unpredictably in others.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管設計時尚，這款設備的表現令人奇怪地捉摸不定（temperamental），在某些情況下反應良好，在其他情況下卻難以預測。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 情緒多變的；難以捉摸的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「temperamental」，意思是「情緒多變的；難以捉摸的」。

questions.question_text: In an effort to _______ public concerns over inappropriate use of priority seats, Taipei MRT revised its policy to prioritize passengers with actual needs, such as fatigue or invisible illness.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 為了平息（assuage）公眾對博愛座被不當使用的擔憂，台北捷運修訂政策，優先考慮有實際需求的乘客，例如疲勞或隱性疾病患者。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「assuage」，意思是「平息；緩和」。

questions.question_text: Many real estate brokers render free service regarding customers' property ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 許多房地產仲介針對客戶的財產估價（appraisals）提供免費服務。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「appraisals」，意思是「估價；評估」。

questions.question_text: Although the instructor had already told everybody to keep quiet, whispers were still ______ spotted among the students.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管教師已告知大家保持安靜，學生之間仍時不時（sporadically）出現竊竊私語聲。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「sporadically」，意思是「零星地；不規則地」。

questions.question_text: Medical researchers indicate that due to some genetic effects, certain feature of parents' constitution will ______ some particular influences in the physical or even mental situation of their children.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 醫學研究人員指出，由於某些遺傳效應，父母體質的某些特徵將引發（precipitate）對其子女身心狀況的特定影響。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「precipitate」，意思是「促使；引發」。

questions.question_text: Despite lacking formal training, the young mathematician solved problems that baffled experienced researchers. Many professors soon regarded him as a(an) ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管缺乏正規訓練，這位年輕數學家解決了令有經驗的研究人員困惑的難題。許多教授很快將他視為一位天才（savant）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「savant」，意思是「天才；博學之人」。

questions.question_text: After months of fruitless job applications and repeated rejection letters, he felt increasingly ______, convinced that no opportunity would appear.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在數月徒勞的求職和一封封拒絕信之後，他越來越感到失落沮喪（forlorn），確信不會有任何機會出現。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「forlorn」，意思是「淒涼的；孤苦無依的」。

questions.question_text: Because the new supervisor encouraged open discussion and maintained a relaxed leadership style, the workplace quickly became far more ______ than it had been under the previous, authoritarian manager.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於新主管鼓勵公開討論並保持輕鬆的領導風格，職場很快變得比前任威權主管時代友善愉快（congenial）得多。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 令人愉快的；氣氛和諧的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「congenial」，意思是「令人愉快的；氣氛和諧的」。

questions.question_text: Although the historian enjoyed widespread admiration, she also had a persistent ______ who regularly published harsh criticisms of her work in academic journals.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管這位歷史學家廣受讚譽，她也有一位固執的批評者（detractor），定期在學術期刊上發表對其作品的嚴厲批評。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「detractor」，意思是「批評者；貶低者」。

questions.question_text: In the editorial, the columnist launched a fierce ___ against corporate greed, criticizing executives with sharp language and uncompromising arguments.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在社論中，這位專欄作家對企業貪婪發動猛烈的抨擊（polemic），用犀利的語言和強硬的論點批評高管。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「polemic」，意思是「激烈抨擊；論戰文章」。

questions.question_text: The professor's lecture on quantum mechanics was so ___ that only advanced researchers could fully grasp its complex theoretical implications.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位教授關於量子力學的講座如此深奧晦澀（esoteric），只有高階研究人員才能完全理解其複雜的理論意涵。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 深奧的；只有少數人懂的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「esoteric」，意思是「深奧的；只有少數人懂的」。

questions.question_text: Her ___ attention to detail ensured that every report was flawless, with no errors overlooked, no matter how minor.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 她對細節一絲不苟（fastidious）的關注確保每份報告都無可挑剔，無論多微小的錯誤都不會被遺漏。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「fastidious」，意思是「一絲不苟的；挑剔的」。

questions.question_text: Although the chemical sounded dangerous, it was actually ___ in small quantities and posed no threat to human health.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然這種化學物質聽起來很危險，但少量使用時實際上是無害的（innocuous），對人體健康不構成威脅。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「innocuous」，意思是「無害的；無毒的」。

questions.question_text: She accepted the challenging task with ___, demonstrating enthusiasm and a cheerful willingness to begin immediately without hesitation.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 她欣然（alacrity）接受了這項艱鉅的任務，展現出熱情和愉快的意願，毫不猶豫地立即開始。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「alacrity」，意思是「欣然；敏捷熱切」。

questions.question_text: The sudden ______ of car horns, construction noise, and shouting voices made it difficult for her to concentrate on her work.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 喇叭聲、施工噪音和叫喊聲突然交織成的嘈雜聲（cacophony），使她難以專心工作。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「cacophony」，意思是「嘈雜聲；刺耳的雜音」。

questions.question_text: The comedian ______ world leaders with his performance, exaggerating their flaws in a humorous yet critical way that resonated with the audience.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位喜劇演員以諷刺性表演嘲諷（lampooned）世界領導人，以幽默而批判的方式誇大他們的缺點，引起觀眾共鳴。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「lampooned」，意思是「諷刺；嘲弄」。

questions.question_text: The teacher was surprisingly ______ when grading the assignments, allowing minor mistakes as long as students demonstrated clear understanding of the concepts.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位老師批改作業時出乎意料地寬鬆（lenient），只要學生展現出對概念的清楚理解，就允許小錯誤的存在。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「lenient」，意思是「寬鬆的；仁慈的」。

questions.question_text: Despite typically maintaining a solemn demeanor, the news anchor appeared remarkably ________ today.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管平時保持嚴肅的態度，這位新聞主播今天看起來格外親切友善（amiable）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「amiable」，意思是「友善的；和藹可親的」。

questions.question_text: Over time, different community groups began to ________ around a shared goal, forming a unified movement that pushed for meaningful social change.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 隨著時間推移，不同的社區團體開始圍繞共同目標凝聚（coalesce），形成一個推動有意義社會變革的統一運動。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「coalesce」，意思是「合併；凝聚」。

questions.question_text: Without new investment or innovation, the local economy remained ______, showing little growth despite ongoing efforts to stimulate development.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 缺乏新投資或創新，當地經濟持續停滯（stagnant），儘管持續努力刺激發展，成長依然微乎其微。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 有韌性的；能快速恢復的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「stagnant」，意思是「停滯的；不流動的」。

questions.question_text: He dismissed the criticism, acting as if it had no impact on him, even though others expected a strong reaction.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他漠然地（nonchalantly）對待批評，表現得好像毫不在意，儘管其他人都預期他會有強烈反應。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 自信果斷地；積極主張地

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「nonchalantly」，意思是「漠然地；若無其事地」。

questions.question_text: After weeks of negotiation, both sides finally agreed to meet halfway and ______, reaching a solution that satisfied everyone involved.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 經過數週的談判，雙方終於同意各退一步，找到共識（find common ground），達成讓所有相關人士滿意的解決方案。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「find common ground」，意思是「找到共識；達成共同點」。

questions.question_text: Although the Ted Talk presentation seemed impressive initially, it quickly became obvious that the speaker was just ______ and knew nothing about the topic.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管這場TED演講一開始看似令人印象深刻，但很快就明顯看出講者不過是在信口開河（talking off the top of his head），對主題一竅不通。

options.label: A
options.text: talking off the top of his head

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「talking off the top of his head」，意思是「信口開河；即興亂說」。

questions.question_text: The victims only had one thing in common—they all looked ________, thin and weary.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 受害者只有一件事相同——他們看起來都面黃肌瘦（gaunt）、形銷骨立且疲憊不堪。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「gaunt」，意思是「瘦削的；憔悴的」。

questions.question_text: It seems to me that we are being unnecessarily ________ on this point.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在我看來，我們在這一點上是不必要地過分挑剔（pernickety）。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 過分挑剔的；苛求細節的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「pernickety」，意思是「過分挑剔的；苛求細節的」。

questions.question_text: His conclusion is ________ with one previously drawn by Thomas.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他的結論與 Thomas 先前得出的結論相符（congruous）。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 秘密會議；（天主教）教皇選舉會議

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「congruous」，意思是「一致的；相符的」。

questions.question_text: In the war arena there isn't even the dimmest light of hope and relief for the weak and ________.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在戰場上，對於弱者和赤貧者（destitute）而言，甚至連一絲希望和解脫的微光都沒有。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「destitute」，意思是「貧窮的；一無所有的」。

questions.question_text: What the company is proposing ________ on the rights of individuals.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這家公司所提議的事項侵犯了（encroaches）個人權利。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「encroaches」，意思是「侵占；侵犯」。

questions.question_text: Despite facing numerous experimental setbacks, the dedicated research team decided to ________ in their quest to find a viable cure for the rare disease.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管面臨無數實驗挫折，這個敬業的研究團隊決定堅持不懈（persevere），繼續尋找罕見疾病的可行療法。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「persevere」，意思是「堅持；不屈不撓」。

questions.question_text: The cautious investors were hesitant to fund the tech startup because the overly optimistic CEO could only offer abstract concepts and vague promises, rather than any ________ evidence of potential profitability.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 謹慎的投資者對資助這家科技新創公司猶豫不決，因為過度樂觀的執行長只能提供抽象概念和模糊承諾，而非任何有形（tangible）的潛在獲利證明。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 似是而非的；表面上合理的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「tangible」，意思是「有形的；切實的」。

questions.question_text: The discovery of new DNA evidence served to completely ________ the suspect, proving beyond a shadow of a doubt that he was not present at the crime scene.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 新的DNA證據的發現徹底洗清了（exonerate）嫌疑人的罪名，毫無疑問地證明他當時不在犯罪現場。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「exonerate」，意思是「免除罪責；洗清」。

questions.question_text: Although the senator had expressed profound doubts about the environmental policy, she ultimately decided to publicly ________ the legislation after witnessing its undeniable success in a neighboring state.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然這位參議員曾對環境政策表示深刻懷疑，但在目睹該立法在鄰州取得不可否認的成功後，她最終決定公開支持（endorse）這項法案。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「endorse」，意思是「支持；認可」。

questions.question_text: Given the strict time limit of the symposium, the speaker was asked to keep her presentation as ________ as possible, carefully excising any superfluous parts from her speech.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 鑑於研討會嚴格的時間限制，演講者被要求盡可能保持演講的簡潔（succinct），仔細刪除演講中任何多餘的部分。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「succinct」，意思是「簡潔的；言簡意賅的」。

questions.question_text: The stranded explorers wandered through the barren wasteland for months; as their supplies dwindled, they soon realized that no amount of foraging might ______ their appetites in such a desolate environment.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那些被困的探險家在荒涼的廢土中流浪了數個月；隨著補給品日益減少，他們很快意識到，在如此荒蕪的環境中，再多的覓食也無法填飽（satiate）他們的胃口。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「satiate」，意思是「使飽足；使滿足」。

questions.question_text: While being transported to the local hospital, the police officer _______ to his injuries caused by the shootout against the armed robbers.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在被送往當地醫院的途中，那名警察因與武裝劫匪的槍戰所造成的傷勢而不治（succumbed）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「succumbed」，意思是「屈服；不治死亡」。

questions.question_text: The university president ______ invited all the faculty members to the gala to celebrate the institution's centenary.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 校長親切地（cordially）邀請了所有教職員參加慶典，慶祝學校成立一百週年。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「cordially」，意思是「熱誠地；親切地」。

questions.question_text: European leaders are striving to secure safe passage for oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, where scattered attacks have ______ maritime traffic, threatening global energy stability.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 歐洲領導人正致力於確保油輪在荷姆茲海峽的安全通行，該海峽零星的攻擊事件已嚴重阻礙（throttled）海上交通，威脅全球能源穩定。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「throttled」，意思是「扼制；嚴重阻礙」。

questions.question_text: The interior designer suggested that they ______ the velvet fabric over the sofa to create a luxurious and cozy atmosphere in the living room.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 室內設計師建議他們將絲絨布料垂掛（drape）在沙發上，以在客廳中營造出奢華舒適的氛圍。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「drape」，意思是「垂掛；披覆」。

questions.question_text: The act of _________ whales for the mere sake of local tradition has enraged animal conservationists.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 僅僅為了當地傳統而大肆屠殺（culling）鯨魚的行為，激怒了動物保育人士。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「culling」，意思是「淘汰屠殺（動物）」。

questions.question_text: The professor's argument was so ____ that even seasoned scholars found themselves reconsidering long-held assumptions.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位教授的論點如此具說服力（cogent），連資深學者都開始重新審視長久以來的假設。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「cogent」，意思是「有說服力的；有力的」。

questions.question_text: The diplomat's ____ remarks defused tension and restored a sense of decorum to the heated debate.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位外交官和解性的（conciliatory）言論化解了緊張氣氛，使激烈的辯論恢復了應有的禮節。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「conciliatory」，意思是「調解的；安撫的」。

questions.question_text: His explanation was dismissed as mere ____; it lacked substance and failed to address the central issue.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他的解釋被視為純粹的空話（verbiage）；內容空洞，未能解決核心問題。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「verbiage」，意思是「囉唆的空話；贅言」。

questions.question_text: The treaty was designed to _______ the decades-long animosity between the two neighboring nations.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這項條約的設計旨在緩和（mollify）兩個鄰國之間長達數十年的敵意。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「mollify」，意思是「緩和；安撫」。

questions.question_text: It is generally acknowledged that the system of bureaucracy has become a _______ machine.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 人們普遍承認，官僚體制已成為一部自我延續（self-perpetuating）的機器。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 自我延續的；自動維持的

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 令人難以置信的；嘆為觀止的

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 久經考驗的；由來已久的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「self-perpetuating」，意思是「自我延續的；自動維持的」。

questions.question_text: The judge ruled that the evidence was _______ to the case and therefore could not be presented in court.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 法官裁定該證據與本案無關（extraneous），因此不得在法庭上呈堂。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「extraneous」，意思是「無關的；多餘的」。

questions.question_text: The study challenges the long-standing ______ that technological innovation, by itself, guarantees equitable social progress.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這項研究挑戰了一個長久以來的公理（axiom）——技術創新本身就能保證公平的社會進步。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「axiom」，意思是「公理；不言而喻的真理」。

questions.question_text: The novel's appeal lies not in overt moral instruction but in its ______ irony, which invites readers to question social norms without prescribing definitive conclusions.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這部小說的魅力不在於公開的道德說教，而在於其諷刺性（sardonic）的反諷，邀請讀者質疑社會規範而不強加明確結論。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「sardonic」，意思是「諷刺的；嘲諷的」。

questions.question_text: The committee's final report adopted a cautiously worded tone, reflecting a deliberate effort to maintain institutional credibility while avoiding any appearance of undue ______ toward the controversial policy.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 委員會的最終報告採用了措辭謹慎的語氣，反映出一種刻意的努力——在維持機構公信力的同時，避免對爭議性政策表現出任何過度順從（acquiescence）的跡象。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「acquiescence」，意思是「默許；順從」。

questions.question_text: In an attempt to restore public confidence, the organization issued a carefully calibrated apology intended to ______ reputational damage rather than eliminate it entirely.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 為了恢復公眾信心，該組織發表了一份精心設計的道歉聲明，旨在改善（ameliorate）聲譽損害，而非完全消除它。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「ameliorate」，意思是「改善；改良」。

questions.question_text: Although the proposal appeared ambitious on the surface, closer scrutiny revealed a ______ organizational structure, with loosely connected sections and objectives that shifted without clear rationale.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然該提案表面上看起來雄心勃勃，但仔細審視後發現其組織結構模糊不清（nebulous），各部分連接鬆散，目標也在缺乏清楚理由的情況下不斷改變。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 有說服力的；令人信服的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「nebulous」，意思是「模糊的；不清晰的」。

questions.question_text: Rather than delivering an overtly moralistic message, the documentary offers a ______ critique of consumer culture, exposing excess through careful observation.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這部紀錄片沒有發出明顯的道德說教，而是提供了一種對消費文化尖銳的（scathing）批評，透過細心觀察來揭露過度消費的問題。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「scathing」，意思是「嚴厲批評的；尖刻的」。

questions.question_text: The speaker's ill-timed attempt at levity disrupted the proceedings, producing a moment of collective ______ that was difficult to dispel.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 演講者時機不當的玩笑打斷了議程，製造了一個集體尷尬（discomfiture）的時刻，令人難以消散。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「discomfiture」，意思是「尷尬；狼狽」。

questions.question_text: The humid heat of the tropical rainforest can quickly ________ even the most energetic hikers, leaving them feeling completely drained of their physical strength.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 熱帶雨林的潮濕高溫能迅速使（enervate）即使是最精力充沛的健行者也感到體力耗盡。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「enervate」，意思是「使精力耗盡；使衰弱」。

questions.question_text: The complex mathematical proof continued to ________ even the most experienced professors in the department, leaving the true solution a mystery for decades.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這個複雜的數學證明持續讓（baffle）系內最資深的教授感到困惑，真正的解答在數十年間依然是個謎。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「baffle」，意思是「使困惑；難住」。

questions.question_text: Upon hearing that his business partner had embezzled millions of dollars, the entrepreneur became _______ with rage, unable to speak.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 得知商業夥伴挪用了數百萬美元後，這位創業家憤怒得（livid）說不出話來。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「livid」，意思是「憤怒的；氣得發紫的」。

questions.question_text: Aspiring writers often find themselves attempting to ________ the prose style of their literary idols before they eventually develop a unique voice of their own.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 有抱負的作家往往發現自己在最終形成獨特聲音之前，會嘗試模仿（emulate）文學偶像的散文風格。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「emulate」，意思是「模仿；效法」。

questions.question_text: In many ancient cultures, warriors would wear a sacred ________ around their necks, believing it possessed the spiritual power to protect them from physical harm.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在許多古代文化中，戰士會在頸部佩戴神聖的護身符（amulet），相信它具有保護他們免受傷害的精神力量。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「amulet」，意思是「護身符；避邪物」。

questions.question_text: Although the theory initially appeared ______ to mainstream scholars, who dismissed it as overly abstract, it later gained acceptance as empirical evidence began to accumulate.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然這個理論起初對主流學者來說顯得深奧難懂（esoteric），被認為過於抽象而遭否定，但隨著實驗證據逐漸積累，它後來獲得了認可。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 深奧的；僅少數人理解的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「esoteric」，意思是「深奧的；僅少數人理解的」。

questions.question_text: Because the manager failed to anticipate the market shift, and instead relied on outdated data, his strategy was widely regarded as ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於這位經理未能預見市場轉變，反而依賴過時的數據，他的策略被普遍認為是失策（imprudent）的。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「imprudent」，意思是「不謹慎的；欠缺考慮的」。

questions.question_text: While her tone seemed polite on the surface, the underlying message was so ______ that several participants felt subtly insulted.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然她的語氣表面上看起來很禮貌，但潛在的訊息如此尖刻（caustic），以至於幾位參與者隱隱感到受辱。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「caustic」，意思是「刻薄的；尖銳批評的」。

questions.question_text: Even though the report was presented as objective, its selective use of data suggests that the conclusions may have been deliberately ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管這份報告以客觀面目呈現，但其選擇性使用數據表明結論可能是故意扭曲（distorted）的。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「distorted」，意思是「扭曲的；失真的」。

questions.question_text: Since the politician had long cultivated an image of integrity, the sudden scandal, which exposed his hidden dealings, appeared particularly ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於這位政治人物長期塑造廉潔形象，突發的醜聞揭露其隱秘交易，顯得格外不協調（incongruous）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「incongruous」，意思是「不協調的；不一致的」。

questions.question_text: Although the instructions were technically accurate, they were so ______ in their wording that users found it difficult to implement them effectively.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然這些說明在技術上是準確的，但措辭如此模糊不清（ambiguous），使用者很難有效地加以實施。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「ambiguous」，意思是「模糊的；含義不明的」。

questions.question_text: As the negotiations progressed and both parties became increasingly rigid in their positions, the likelihood of reaching an agreement began to ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 隨著談判進展，雙方立場越來越強硬，達成協議的可能性開始減退（wane）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「wane」，意思是「減退；衰落」。

questions.question_text: While the proposal aimed to address systemic issues, its overly simplistic approach rendered it largely ______ in practice.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然該提案旨在解決系統性問題，但其過於簡化的方法在實踐中使其大體上無效（ineffective）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「ineffective」，意思是「無效的；不起作用的」。

questions.question_text: Because the witness had altered her testimony multiple times, and could not provide consistent details, her account was deemed ______ by the jury.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於這名證人多次更改證詞，且無法提供一致的細節，陪審團認為她的陳述不可信（unreliable）。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 貌似合理的；看似可信的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「unreliable」，意思是「不可靠的；不可信的」。

questions.question_text: Although he claimed to be indifferent to criticism, his defensive reactions, which often escalated minor disagreements, suggested a rather ______ disposition.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然他聲稱對批評漠然，但他的防衛性反應往往使小分歧升級，顯示出相當缺乏安全感（insecure）的個性。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 有韌性的；不易被擊垮的

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 缺乏安全感的；不確定的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「insecure」，意思是「缺乏安全感的；不確定的」。

questions.question_text: Since the data set was incomplete and several variables were overlooked, any conclusions drawn from the study would be inherently ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於數據集不完整且忽略了幾個變數，從該研究得出的任何結論本質上都是推測性的（speculative）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「speculative」，意思是「推測的；投機的」。

questions.question_text: While the CEO's speech was intended to reassure investors, its vague promises and lack of concrete plans made it sound decidedly ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管執行長的演講旨在安撫投資者，但其空泛的承諾和缺乏具體計畫，使其聽起來明顯敷衍了事（perfunctory）。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 引人注目的；有說服力的

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 有說服力的；令人信服的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「perfunctory」，意思是「敷衍了事的；草率的」。

questions.question_text: Even though the artist rejected traditional forms, and sought to challenge aesthetic norms, his work was criticized as unnecessarily ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管這位藝術家拒絕傳統形式並試圖挑戰審美規範，他的作品仍被批評為不必要地晦澀難懂（obscure）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「obscure」，意思是「晦澀的；不知名的」。

questions.question_text: As the company expanded rapidly into international markets, its once cohesive corporate culture became increasingly ______, leading to internal conflicts.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 隨著公司迅速向國際市場擴張，曾經凝聚一致的企業文化越來越分散（fragmented），導致內部衝突。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「fragmented」，意思是「分散的；碎片化的」。

questions.question_text: Although the scholar's argument was intricate and supported by extensive references, its overly dense structure made it largely ______ to general readers.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然這位學者的論點錯綜複雜且有大量引用支撐，但其過於密集的結構使其對一般讀者而言幾乎晦澀難解（inscrutable）。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 難以理解的；高深莫測的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「inscrutable」，意思是「難以理解的；高深莫測的」。

questions.question_text: In Virginia Woolf's prose, the author meticulously captures the ________ nature of human consciousness, portraying the internal world as a series of flickering, short-lived impressions that dissolve almost as soon as they emerge.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在維吉尼亞·吳爾夫的散文中，作者細膩地捕捉了人類意識的短暫消逝（evanescent）特性，將內心世界描繪為一系列轉瞬即逝的印象，幾乎在浮現的瞬間便已消散。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 短暫消逝的；轉瞬即逝的

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 根深蒂固的；積習難改的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「evanescent」，意思是「短暫消逝的；轉瞬即逝的」。

questions.question_text: The ________ network of biochemical pathways within a single cell ensures that energy production is perfectly synchronized with the organism's metabolic needs, preventing any wasteful expenditure of resources.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 單個細胞內錯綜複雜（labyrinthine）的生化通路網絡，確保能量生產與生物體的代謝需求完美同步，防止任何資源的浪費。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 如迷宮般複雜的；錯綜的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「labyrinthine」，意思是「如迷宮般複雜的；錯綜的」。

questions.question_text: The successful implementation of the smart grid in the science city is a result of the ________ of various renewable energy sources, creating a unified and resilient power ecosystem that was previously fragmented.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 科學城智慧電網的成功實施，是各種再生能源整合匯聚（coalescence）的結果，創造了一個以往分散的統一且有韌性的電力生態系統。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「coalescence」，意思是「合併；凝聚」。

questions.question_text: The movement of magma within a dormant volcano is often ________; while geologists can monitor subtle pressure shifts, the exact timing of a potential eruption remains a matter of probability rather than deterministic certainty.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 休眠火山內岩漿的運動往往是隨機的（stochastic）；儘管地質學家能夠監測到細微的壓力變化，但潛在噴發的確切時間仍屬機率範疇，而非確定性事實。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「stochastic」，意思是「隨機的；機率的」。

questions.question_text: The extreme sensitivity of qubits makes them highly ________ to external decoherence; consequently, even the most minute thermal vibration can lead to the instantaneous collapse of a delicate quantum state.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 量子位元的極度敏感性使其極易受到（vulnerable）外部退相干的影響；因此，即使是最微小的熱振動也可能導致脆弱量子態的瞬間崩潰。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vulnerable」，意思是「易受傷害的；脆弱的」。

questions.question_text: Despite the seemingly ________ nature of the Earth's lithosphere when viewed over a human lifespan, geological records confirm that tectonic plates are in a state of constant, albeit gradual, flux.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管以人類壽命的時間尺度來看，地球岩石圈似乎是不可改變的（immutable），但地質記錄證實，構造板塊正處於持續的——儘管緩慢的——流動狀態。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「immutable」，意思是「不可改變的；永恆的」。

questions.question_text: Environmentalists argue that we must adopt a new ________ in how we view nature, moving away from seeing it as a resource to be exploited and toward seeing it as a system to be preserved.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 環保人士認為，我們必須在看待自然的方式上採用新的典範（paradigm），從將其視為待開採的資源，轉向將其視為需要保護的系統。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「paradigm」，意思是「典範；範例」。

questions.question_text: Odysseus's fatal flaw was his ________; it was this excessive pride that compelled him to taunt the Cyclops, a decision that subsequently incurred the wrath of Poseidon and prolonged his journey home by a decade.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 奧德修斯的致命弱點是他的傲慢（hubris）；正是這種過度的驕傲迫使他嘲諷獨眼巨人，這一決定隨後激怒了波塞頓，使他的歸途延長了十年。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「hubris」，意思是「傲慢；自負」。

questions.question_text: The author intentionally crafted a protagonist whose outward humility is ________ to his latent, overwhelming vanity, thereby creating a psychological tension that remains unresolved until the final chapter.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 作者刻意塑造了一個主人公，其外在的謙遜與潛藏的強烈虛榮心恰恰相反（antithetical），從而創造了一種貫穿全書直到最後一章才得以化解的心理張力。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「antithetical」，意思是「對立的；截然相反的」。

questions.question_text: Instead of chasing idealistic goals, the committee decided to take a _____ approach to solve the immediate budget issues.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 委員會沒有追求理想化的目標，而是決定採取務實（pragmatic）的方式來解決眼前的預算問題。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「pragmatic」，意思是「務實的；實際的」。

questions.question_text: In the modern era, smartphones have become _____, changing the way people communicate and access information.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在現代，智慧型手機已無所不在（ubiquitous），改變了人們溝通和獲取資訊的方式。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 無所不在的；普遍存在的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「ubiquitous」，意思是「無所不在的；普遍存在的」。

questions.question_text: After evaluating the budget and manpower, the school board concluded that the new bilingual program was indeed _____ for the next semester.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在評估預算和人力後，校董事會得出結論，新的雙語課程在下學期確實是可行的（feasible）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「feasible」，意思是「可行的；切實可行的」。

questions.question_text: The scientist noticed a(n) _____ data point in the experiment that contradicted all previous findings, prompting a deeper investigation.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 科學家在實驗中注意到一個與所有先前發現相矛盾的異常（anomalous）數據點，促使進行了更深入的調查。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「anomalous」，意思是「異常的；不合常規的」。

questions.question_text: As educators, we must be _____ of the diverse learning needs of our students to provide a truly inclusive environment.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 身為教育工作者，我們必須充分認識（cognizant）學生多元的學習需求，才能提供真正包容的環境。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「cognizant」，意思是「認識到的；知悉的」。

questions.question_text: Despite being an expert in the field, he remained _______ during the meeting, preferring to listen to others' opinions first.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管是該領域的專家，他在會議中仍然沉默寡言（reticent），偏好先傾聽他人的意見。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「reticent」，意思是「沉默的；不輕易表達的」。

questions.question_text: Known for his ________ speaking style, the professor often filled his lectures with obscure references and highly technical terminology, leaving even well-trained scholars struggling to follow his line of reasoning.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位教授以其深奧難懂（recondite）的演講風格著稱，講課時常充滿晦澀的典故和高度專業的術語，使連訓練有素的學者也難以跟上他的思路。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 輕鬆愉快的；漫不經心的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「recondite」，意思是「深奧的；晦澀難懂的」。

questions.question_text: After the embezzlement scandal was revealed, the disgraced politician's reputation was beyond ________, making any hope of a political comeback impossible.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 挪用公款醜聞曝光後，這位聲名狼藉的政客名譽已無從挽回（redemption），任何政治東山再起的希望都成為泡影。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「redemption」，意思是「救贖；挽回」。

questions.question_text: The ________ of the monarch was absolute; no one dared to challenge his decrees, lest they face immediate imprisonment or exile.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位君主的霸權（hegemony）是絕對的；無人敢挑戰其法令，唯恐立即遭到監禁或流放。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「hegemony」，意思是「霸權；支配地位」。

questions.question_text: In the wake of the tragedy, the community fell into a state of ________, where a deep-seated indifference toward the future seemed to paralyze all collective action.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在悲劇發生後，這個社區陷入了一種麻木停滯（torpor）的狀態，對未來根深柢固的冷漠似乎癱瘓了所有集體行動。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「torpor」，意思是「麻木；停滯不動」。

questions.question_text: The detective found it difficult to trust the witness, whose ________ responses and shifty eyes suggested that he was concealing crucial details about the night in question.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 偵探發現很難信任這名證人，其謊言連連（mendacious）的回應和游移的眼神暗示他正隱瞞案發當晚的重要細節。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「mendacious」，意思是「說謊的；不誠實的」。

questions.question_text: Despite the ________ conditions of the desert, the nomadic tribes have developed ingenious methods for gathering water and sustaining life.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管沙漠環境惡劣（inclement），這些遊牧部落已發展出巧妙的方法來蒐集水源和維持生計。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「inclement」，意思是「惡劣的（天氣）；嚴酷的」。

questions.question_text: The literary critic's ________ review was filled with sharp insults, comparing the author's latest novel to a pile of uninspired refuse.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位文學評論家充滿惡意（vitriolic）的評論充斥著尖銳的侮辱，將作者最新的小說比作一堆毫無靈感的廢物。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 異想天開的；充滿奇思妙想的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vitriolic」，意思是「充滿惡意的；刻毒的」。

questions.question_text: The CEO's ________ toward his employees was legendary; he treated everyone from the janitors to the vice presidents with the same haughty condescension.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位執行長對員工的傲慢（superciliousness）是出了名的；從清潔工到副總裁，他以同樣高傲的態度俯視所有人。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「superciliousness」，意思是「傲慢；目中無人」。

questions.question_text: The old Victorian mansion, with its peeling paint and overgrown garden, exuded a(n) ________ atmosphere that made the neighborhood children believe it was haunted.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這棟老舊的維多利亞式豪宅，油漆剝落、花園叢生，散發出一種陰森（sepulchral）的氛圍，使附近的孩子們相信它鬧鬼。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「sepulchral」，意思是「陰森的；墓地般的」。

questions.question_text: The treaty was criticized for being ________, as it provided only a temporary pause in hostilities without addressing the underlying territorial disputes.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這項條約因其臨時性（makeshift）而遭到批評，因為它只是暫時中止敵對行動，而未解決潛在的領土爭端。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「makeshift」，意思是「臨時湊合的；暫時的」。

questions.question_text: Throughout the negotiations, the diplomat remained ________, refusing to compromise even on the most minor points of the agreement.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在整個談判過程中，這位外交官始終堅持不妥協（intransigent），拒絕在協議的最細微之處做出讓步。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「intransigent」，意思是「不妥協的；頑固的」。

questions.question_text: The artist's ________ use of color creates a sense of depth and vibration that makes her abstract paintings appear almost three-dimensional.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位藝術家對色彩明智（judicious）的運用創造出一種深度感和震動感，使她的抽象畫幾乎呈現出立體效果。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「judicious」，意思是「明智的；有判斷力的」。

questions.question_text: Many regarded the general's decision to retreat as a(n) ________ act, though he insisted it was a strategic move to preserve his remaining forces.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 許多人認為將軍下令撤退的決定是懦弱（craven）之舉，儘管他堅稱這是為了保存剩餘兵力的戰略行動。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「craven」，意思是「懦弱的；膽怯的」。

questions.question_text: The politician's response to the corruption allegations was a masterpiece of ________; he neither admitted wrongdoing nor directly denied the accusations, leaving the public uncertain about what he actually meant.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位政治人物對腐敗指控的回應是含糊其辭（equivocation）的傑作；他既不承認過失，也不直接否認指控，使公眾對他的真實意思感到困惑。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「equivocation」，意思是「含糊其辭；兩可之詞」。

questions.question_text: His ________ remarks during the funeral, though intended to be funny, were deeply offensive to the grieving family members.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他在葬禮上輕率（flippant）的言論，雖然本意是搞笑，卻令悲傷的家屬深感冒犯。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「flippant」，意思是「輕率的；不嚴肅的」。

questions.question_text: The scholar spent a decade writing a(n) ________ commentary on the ancient text, analyzing every single word for its historical and linguistic significance.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位學者花了十年時間撰寫一篇對古代文獻的詳盡詮釋（exegesis），分析每一個詞的歷史和語言學意義。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 詳盡詮釋；（尤指聖經）解釋

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「exegesis」，意思是「詳盡詮釋；（尤指聖經）解釋」。

questions.question_text: The cult leader's ________ personality allowed him to manipulate his followers into surrendering all of their worldly possessions to his organization.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位邪教頭目有魅力（charismatic）的個性使他能夠操縱信徒將所有世俗財產交給他的組織。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 有個人魅力的；吸引人的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「charismatic」，意思是「有個人魅力的；吸引人的」。

questions.question_text: The Supreme Court eventually struck down the statute as ________, ruling that it was inherently discriminatory and fundamentally incompatible with the nation's founding principles of equality.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 最高法院最終以不合理歧視性（invidious）為由推翻了該法令，裁定其本質上具有歧視性，且與國家立國的平等原則根本不相容。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 引起憤恨的；不公平歧視性的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「invidious」，意思是「引起憤恨的；不公平歧視性的」。

questions.question_text: After the long winter, the valley was filled with ________ vegetation, as the melting snow provided ample water for the spring bloom.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 漫長的冬季過後，山谷裡充滿了茂盛（luxuriant）的植被，因為融化的積雪為春季盛開提供了充足的水源。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「luxuriant」，意思是「茂盛的；豐盛的」。

questions.question_text: The ________ of the two rivers created a massive whirlpool that was dangerous for even the most experienced boaters to navigate.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 兩條河流的匯流（confluence）形成了一個巨大的漩渦，即使是最有經驗的船員也難以安全航行。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「confluence」，意思是「匯流；聚集」。

questions.question_text: Although the evidence against the suspect seemed overwhelming, his lawyer remained ________, refusing to admit defeat in court.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然針對嫌疑人的證據看似確鑿，他的律師仍然頑固地（intransigent）拒絕在法庭上認輸。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「intransigent」，意思是「不妥協的；頑固的」。

questions.question_text: The professor's sophisticated lecture was so ________ that even the most diligent students struggled to grasp the core concepts.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位教授精深的講座如此艱澀難懂（abstruse），連最用功的學生也難以掌握核心概念。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「abstruse」，意思是「深奧的；難以理解的」。

questions.question_text: To compensate for the insufficient budget, the manager adopted a ________ approach, cutting all unnecessary expenses immediately.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 為了彌補預算不足，經理採取了極為節儉（parsimonious）的方式，立即削減所有不必要的開支。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「parsimonious」，意思是「極度節儉的；吝嗇的」。

questions.question_text: The primitive tribe's mysterious rituals have remained ________ for centuries, despite many comprehensive studies by modern anthropologists.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管現代人類學家進行了許多全面的研究，這個原始部落神秘的儀式數百年來仍然令人費解（enigmatic）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「enigmatic」，意思是「謎樣的；費解的」。

questions.question_text: After the unexpected scandal, the politician tried to ________ the public's indignation by offering a sincere, formal apology.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在突發醜聞之後，這位政治人物試圖透過誠懇的正式道歉來平息（placate）公眾的憤慨。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「placate」，意思是「安撫；平息」。

questions.question_text: The versatile actor is famous for his ________ personality, easily switching between melancholy and extreme joy in a single scene.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位多才多藝的演員以其善變（mercurial）的個性著稱，能在同一場景中輕易切換於憂鬱與極度歡喜之間。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 大洪水前的；極為老舊的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「mercurial」，意思是「善變的；情緒多變的」。

questions.question_text: It is inevitable that superficial trends will be ________, lasting only a few months before they are completely forgotten.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 膚淺的流行趨勢必然是短暫的（ephemeral），往往只風行幾個月便被徹底遺忘。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「ephemeral」，意思是「短暫的；轉瞬即逝的」。

questions.question_text: His persistent and provocative comments were intended to ________ a strong reaction from the conservative audience members.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他持續且具煽動性的言論，目的是要激起（instigate）保守派聽眾的強烈反應。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「instigate」，意思是「煽動；激起」。

questions.question_text: The CEO's authoritative and ________ style of leadership discouraged any constructive feedback from the junior employees.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位執行長威權且獨裁（dictatorial）的領導風格，使基層員工不敢提出任何建設性意見。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「dictatorial」，意思是「獨裁的；專制的」。

questions.question_text: The scientist's revolutionary theory was initially met with skepticism, as it seemed ________ to the established laws of physics.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位科學家革命性的理論起初遭到質疑，因為它似乎與既有的物理學定律相悖（anomalous）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「anomalous」，意思是「異常的；不符常規的」。

questions.question_text: The unexpected discovery of ancient ruins seemed to ______ the entire archaeological team, who immediately intensified their excavation efforts.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 古代遺址的意外發現似乎激勵了（galvanize）整個考古團隊，他們立即加大了挖掘力度。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「galvanize」，意思是「激勵；刺激行動」。

questions.question_text: The prisoner was ______ even though he presented evidence clearly proving that he was nowhere near the scene of the crime.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管囚犯呈上了清楚證明他根本不在犯罪現場附近的證據，他仍然被起訴（indicted）。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 被起訴的；被正式控告的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「indicted」，意思是「被起訴的；被正式控告的」。

questions.question_text: The region's ______ climate, shifting from sunshine to violent storms within hours, made farming extremely unpredictable.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 該地區反覆無常（capricious）的氣候，在數小時內從陽光明媚變為猛烈風暴，使農業極難預測。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「capricious」，意思是「反覆無常的；任性的」。

questions.question_text: If you are going to make an official complaint, make sure you have a human resources ______ present during your meeting.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 如果你要提出正式投訴，請確保你的會議中有一名人力資源聯絡人（liaison）在場。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「liaison」，意思是「聯絡人；協調員」。

questions.question_text: One rude staff member does not accurately represent our entire dedicated team. Please don't make a ______ about our restaurant based on your bad experience with that one waiter.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 一名粗魯的員工並不能準確代表我們整個敬業的團隊。請不要因為那一名服務員的不良服務而對我們的餐廳做出概括性判斷（generalization）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「generalization」，意思是「概括；一般化」。

questions.question_text: Despite years of failed trials and relentless criticism, she remained ______, refusing to abandon her research even when funding was withdrawn.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管多年的試驗失敗和不斷的批評，她仍然堅韌不拔（tenacious），即使在資金撤回後也拒絕放棄她的研究。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 無精打采的；昏昏欲睡的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「tenacious」，意思是「堅韌的；頑強的」。

questions.question_text: Heavy fog and unpredictable crosswinds began to ______ the climbers' progress, forcing them to halt their ascent midway up the mountain.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 濃霧和難以預測的側風開始阻礙（impede）攀登者的進展，迫使他們在山腰中途停止攀升。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「impede」，意思是「阻礙；妨礙」。

questions.question_text: After a formal inquiry confirmed serious misconduct, the board voted to publicly ______ the executive for breaching ethical standards.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在正式調查確認嚴重不當行為後，董事會投票公開譴責（censure）這位高管違反道德標準。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「censure」，意思是「譴責；批評」。

questions.question_text: His sudden withdrawal from negotiations, made without consulting advisers, was widely criticized as ______ and poorly considered.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他在未徵詢顧問意見的情況下突然退出談判，被廣泛批評為衝動魯莽（impetuous）且欠缺考慮。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「impetuous」，意思是「衝動的；魯莽的」。

questions.question_text: While attempting to downplay the misunderstanding, she ______ brought up a past incident that complicated matters further, instantly realizing she had revealed far more than she intended.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在試圖淡化誤解的過程中，她無意中（inadvertently）提起了一個讓事情更加複雜的過去事件，立即意識到她透露的遠比她本意要多。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 無可攻擊地；無懈可擊地

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「inadvertently」，意思是「無意中；不小心地」。

questions.question_text: The child's ______ honesty made everyone uncomfortable.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這個孩子天真無邪（ingenuous）的誠實讓大家感到不自在。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「ingenuous」，意思是「天真的；坦誠的」。

questions.question_text: She is an ______ reader who enjoys everything from history to comics.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 她是個什麼都讀（omnivorous）的讀者，從歷史到漫畫都喜歡。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 什麼都吃（或讀）的；雜食的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「omnivorous」，意思是「什麼都吃（或讀）的；雜食的」。

questions.question_text: He grew ______ after years of success and stopped trying to improve his performance.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 多年成功後，他變得自滿（complacent），不再努力提升表現。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「complacent」，意思是「自滿的；沾沾自喜的」。

questions.question_text: The new regulations aim to __________ the environmental impact of industrial activities in the area.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 新規定旨在緩解（mitigate）該地區工業活動對環境的影響。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「mitigate」，意思是「減輕；緩和」。

questions.question_text: Critics argue that the education system continues to ______ social inequality rather than challenge it.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 批評者認為，教育體制持續根深柢固（entrench）社會不平等，而非挑戰它。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「entrench」，意思是「使根深柢固；鞏固」。

questions.question_text: The company was criticized for its ______ treatment of workers, which violated basic ethical standards.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這家公司因其應受譴責（reprehensible）的對待員工方式而受到批評，違反了基本道德標準。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「reprehensible」，意思是「應受譴責的；有過失的」。

questions.question_text: Critics warned that the proposed law would seriously ______ on fundamental civil liberties, raising constitutional concerns.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 批評者警告，擬議中的法律將嚴重侵害（infringe）基本公民自由，引發憲法層面的擔憂。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「infringe」，意思是「侵害；違反」。

questions.question_text: The lecture was so ______ that only experts in the field could fully understand it.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這場講座如此深奧難懂（esoteric），只有該領域的專家才能完全理解。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 深奧的；只有少數人懂的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「esoteric」，意思是「深奧的；只有少數人懂的」。

questions.question_text: His calm response in a difficult situation seemed to ______ great confidence and experience.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他在困難情況下的冷靜回應似乎顯示出（betoken）極大的自信和經驗。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「betoken」，意思是「顯示；預示」。
