questions.question_text: He has a strong ______ for staying up late, even when he knows he has an early meeting the next day.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 即使知道隔天有早會，他仍有熬夜的強烈傾向（proclivity）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「proclivity」，意思是「傾向；嗜好」。

questions.question_text: The machine is powerful enough to ______ rocks into fine powder within seconds.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這台機器功能強大，能在幾秒鐘內將岩石磨成（pulverize）細粉。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「pulverize」，意思是「磨成粉末；徹底摧毀」。

questions.question_text: The extra decorations only ______ the elegance of the design.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 多餘的裝飾只會損害（detract from）設計的優雅。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「detract from」，意思是「損害；減損」。

questions.question_text: The child was considered ______, demonstrating unusually advanced intellectual abilities for his age.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這個孩子被認為是早熟的天才（precocious），展現出超乎年齡的異常先進智力能力。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「precocious」，意思是「早熟的；早慧的」。

questions.question_text: If the learners ______ more opportunities for interaction, they ______ developed greater communicative competence than what was observed.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 如果學習者當時獲得更多互動機會（had been given），他們本會（would have）比實際觀察到的發展出更強的溝通能力。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 與事實相反的過去假設語氣

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「had been given / would have」，意思是「與事實相反的過去假設語氣」。

questions.question_text: The guidelines were revised to ensure that all procedures ______ strictly followed, lest any deviation ______ the reliability of the findings.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 指導方針已修訂，以確保所有程序得（be）嚴格遵守，以免任何偏差影響（affect）研究結果的可靠性。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: ensure後接虛擬語氣be；lest後接原形動詞

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「be / affect」，意思是「ensure後接虛擬語氣be；lest後接原形動詞」。

questions.question_text: ______ more attention to learner variability, the study might not have overlooked the factors that ______ to differences in performance across groups.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 如果該研究當時更關注學習者差異（Had it paid），就可能不會忽略造成（contributed）各組表現差異的因素。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 過去事實相反假設倒裝語氣

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Had it paid / contributed」，意思是「過去事實相反假設倒裝語氣」。

questions.question_text: The belief ______ learners develop grammatical competence primarily through exposure has been challenged by researchers ______ conclusions, which several critics contend ______ insufficiently grounded, have influenced current pedagogical practices.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 認為學習者主要透過接觸語言培養語法能力的信念（that）已受到研究人員的挑戰，這些研究人員的（whose）結論被若干批評者認為（are）缺乏充分根據，卻影響了當前的教學實踐。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: that引名詞子句；whose表所有格；are與複數主詞一致

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: （which作所有格有誤；is與複數主詞不符）

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「that / whose / are」，意思是「that引名詞子句；whose表所有格；are與複數主詞一致」。

questions.question_text: The researchers found the participants ______ significantly better when exposed to authentic input.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 研究人員發現參與者在接觸真實語料時，表現（performing）明顯更好。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: （find + O + 原形動詞不符慣用法）

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: （find + O + to V較少用於此語境）

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: （find + O + 過去分詞表被動，語意不符）

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「performing」，意思是「find + O + V-ing：發現⋯⋯正在做」。

questions.question_text: While the proposal has been widely praised for its innovative design, several analysts—citing inconsistencies in the underlying data—have taken issue ______ the assumptions on which its conclusions rest.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然該提案因其創新設計受到廣泛讚譽，但幾位分析師——以基礎數據中的不一致為由——對其結論所依賴的假設提出了異議（take issue with）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「with」，意思是「take issue with：對⋯⋯提出異議」。

questions.question_text: The argument is predicated ______ a distinction that, upon closer examination, proves far less clear-cut than initially assumed.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這個論點以某個區別為前提（predicated on），但仔細審視後發現，這個區別遠不如最初假設的那樣界限分明。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「on」，意思是「predicated on：以⋯⋯為前提」。

questions.question_text: During the lecture, the professor tended to ______ from the main topic, sharing unrelated anecdotes that confused students and disrupted coherence.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在講課期間，這位教授常常偏離（digress）主題，分享與課程無關的軼事，讓學生感到困惑並破壞了內容的連貫性。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「digress」，意思是「偏離主題；扯遠了」。

questions.question_text: Prices of essential goods tend to ______ throughout the year due to seasonal demand, economic conditions, and unexpected global events.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於季節性需求、經濟狀況和意外全球事件，必需品的價格全年往往有所波動（fluctuate）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「fluctuate」，意思是「波動；起伏不定」。

questions.question_text: The ______ traveler ventured into remote regions, facing unpredictable conditions with remarkable confidence and determination.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位無所畏懼（intrepid）的旅行者深入偏遠地區，以非凡的自信和決心面對難以預料的環境。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「intrepid」，意思是「無所畏懼的；勇敢的」。

questions.question_text: The funds were intended for educational programs, but investigators discovered they had been misused for ______ purposes unrelated to student development.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這筆資金原本是用於教育計畫的，但調查人員發現它被挪用於與學生發展無關的瑣碎（frivolous）目的。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「frivolous」，意思是「無聊輕率的；不重要的」。

questions.question_text: Epidemiologists warn that without robust global vaccination equity, the virus will not be eradicated but rather become ______, circulating perpetually within vulnerable populations.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 流行病學家警告，若沒有強大的全球疫苗接種公平性，病毒將無法被根除，而會成為地方性（endemic）的，永久在脆弱群體中循環。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 全球性流行的；大流行病

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「endemic」，意思是「地方性的；某地特有的」。

questions.question_text: Savvy institutional investors employ complex hedging strategies to insulate their portfolios from the sudden ______ of the global equities market.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 精明的機構投資者採用複雜的對沖策略，以使其投資組合免受全球股票市場突然變化（vicissitudes）的影響。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vicissitudes」，意思是「變遷；無常」。

questions.question_text: The peace talks collapsed predominantly due to the ______ of the rebel faction, whose leaders categorically refused to compromise on their maximalist territorial demands.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 和平談判主要因叛亂派系的頑固不妥協（intransigence）而破裂，其領導人斷然拒絕在最大化的領土主張上作出任何讓步。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「intransigence」，意思是「不妥協；頑固」。

questions.question_text: Instead of rejecting the proposal outright, the diplomat attempted to ______, giving ambiguous answers in the hope that circumstances would shift before a final decision became necessary.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位外交官沒有直接拒絕提案，而是試圖拖延敷衍（temporize），給出模糊的回答，希望在必須做出最終決定之前形勢能有所轉變。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「temporize」，意思是「拖延；敷衍」。

questions.question_text: When the coach heard about the referee's decision, he spoke ______ and loudly criticized the call.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 當教練得知裁判的判決時，他厲聲（vituperatively）大聲批評了這個判定。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 以惡言謾罵地；嚴厲批評地

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 無緣無故地；多此一舉地

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vituperatively」，意思是「以惡言謾罵地；嚴厲批評地」。

questions.question_text: Although he bore the title of chairman, insiders recognized that he was merely a ______, a powerless figure manipulated by influential financiers who dictated every decision.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然他頂著董事長的頭銜，但內部人士都清楚他不過是個虛設的傀儡（cipher），一個被呼風喚雨的金融家操縱、左右每一項決策的無權人物。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「cipher」，意思是「無足輕重的人；傀儡」。
